indication: The treatment of adults with mismatch repair deficient (dMMR) / microsatellite instability-high (MSI-H) primary advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer and who are candidates for systemic therapy.
description: The Republic of Ireland's Health Service Executive (HSE) has approved dostarlimab in combination with carboplatin and paclitaxel as a treatment option for the treatment of adult patients with primary advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer whose tumors are mismatch repair deficient (dMMR) or microsatellite instability-high (MSI-H) and who are candidates for systemic therapy.
reimbursement_comment: dostarlimab - ODMS; carboplatin and paclitaxel - N/A
